concept.title: Connect your Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform environment
concept.shortdesc: You can connect your Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform environment to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a cloud integration, so that the cost management service on the Hybrid Cloud Console can use data from your environment to track your cloud costs.

conbody.p: You can use the cost management service to perform financially related tasks, such as:

ul.li: Visualizing, understanding, and analyzing the use of resources and costs
Forecasting your future consumption and comparing them with budgets
Identifying patterns of usage for further analysis
Integrating with third-party tools that can benefit from cost and resourcing data

note.p: For Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.6 and later, install the costmanagement-metrics-operator from the OpenShift Container Platform web console.

link.linktext: Integrate OpenShift Container Platform data into cost management
